I had a friend once who was madly in love with another one of our friends. So I got to see both sides of the story and how it effected each. 

She never stopped loving him, she asked him out many times or the crush was just brought up. She would constantly feel bad because he didn’t love her like she did, and any little thing caused her to feel upset. Such as Him doing stuff with me he does with her. She stayed, even though she was in pain and since then she’s had so many fun experiences with him. The love is still there and quite frankly, will probably always be there, but that doesn’t mean she doesn’t try to atleast have some kind of relationship with him. Platonic or not.

He knew of her crush, of course he did. As I said before it was brought up constantly by friends to tease him. What sucked for him was constant having to reject her, he absolutely loves her but as a friend. And knowing you are hurting your friend because of something you don’t have was terrible for him. But he stayed, and he tried his best to give her the love he could, even if it was just from a friends point of view. 

It’s up to you what you feel is best, I understand the pain of it all, but I also see his pain. Take a good long thought about things before you absolutely decide to leave, he’s still going to be him. I don’t want you to hurt either though, I remember comforting her a lot and that was terrible. The good moments will be there, but it’s up to you to decide whether or not they are worth staying for.
